description:
Use this when the user wants a photo brought into RipClip to edit it: "edit my picture", "fix the colors on
this image". Up to 24 MB, kept at its own size. Returns job_id; job_status's clip_ids then holds the photo's id
for the edit tools.
Not for: videos (import_video) or changing what is in the picture, such as removing a person. Free.

PhotoFile.description: a file the user attached in ChatGPT (Apps SDK openai/fileParams: download_url and file_id always come)
PhotoFile.title: PhotoFile

file.description: A picture the user attached in the chat, passed by the assistant. Give this or url.

url.description: https link to a .jpg, .png or .webp picture, or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link open to anyone with the link. Empty if file is given.
